# discord_auto_moderation_rules (Data Source)

Lists the AutoMod rules of a server. Requires the Manage Server permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_auto_moderation_rules" "all" {
  server_id = var.server_id
}

output "disabled_rules" {
  value = [for r in data.discord_auto_moderation_rules.all.rules : r.name if !r.enabled]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes List) The rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `action_types` (List of String) Types of the actions the rule takes, in order: `block_message`, `send_alert_message`, `timeout`, `block_member_interaction`.
- `creator_id` (String) ID of the user who created the rule.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled.
- `event_type` (String) Event that triggers the rule: `message_send`, `member_update`.
- `exempt_channel_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the channels the rule does not apply to.
- `exempt_role_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the roles the rule does not apply to.
- `id` (String) Rule ID.
- `name` (String) Rule name.
- `trigger_type` (String) What the rule checks for: `keyword`, `spam`, `keyword_preset`, `mention_spam`, `member_profile`.
